Sanitary Sewer Overflow Reported on May 27, 2020 at 1234 Example Court

At 3:50 p.m. May 27, 2020, Water Pollution Control (WPC) was notified of sewage coming out of a manhole next to 1234 Example Court. Crews found the overflow running into a stream that runs into Five-Mile Creek. City crews cleared the main, which stopped the overflow at 6:00 p.m. WPC estimated 2,500 gallons of wastewater was released from the system. Signs that read "Creek Contaminated" were posted. The City asks that residents stay away from the creek water until testing is done and signs are removed.
